answers.core: Position of nodes is already a core feature, so it would be logical to keep it's corrections/enhancementsin the core as well.
answers.workaround:
I think positioning and layering nodes is used very often. I imagine, giving it more flexibility should be a desired course of action.
I can also imagine, that this kind of feature can be (like most limitations) worked around somehow.
